name: jenkins
description: Jenkins CI/CD integration — list jobs (including folder-nested jobs), inspect job health and build details, read console logs, view the build queue, and trigger builds with or without parameters. Authenticates with a per-user Jenkins API token sent as HTTP Basic auth (username:apiToken); API-token requests are CSRF-exempt so no crumb is needed. All read responses are bounded with tree= field selection so large instances stay fast.
author: Buildersoft LLC

integration.description: Jenkins CI/CD jobs, builds, and queue via the remote access API

fields.label: Jenkins URL
fields.helpText: Base URL of your Jenkins instance (e.g. https://jenkins.example.com). Must be reachable from Sophon — VPN-only instances will not work.

fields.label: Username
fields.helpText: Your Jenkins username (the account the API token belongs to).

fields.label: API Token
fields.helpText: Generate at {your Jenkins URL}/me/configure under API Token — Add new token.

tools.name: jenkins.list_jobs
tools.description: List Jenkins jobs at the top level or inside a folder, with each job's name, URL, latest status (success, failed, unstable, ...), whether it is currently building, and whether it is a folder.

folder.description: Folder path to list jobs under (e.g. team-a or team-a/subfolder). Omit for the top level.

tools.name: jenkins.get_job
tools.description: Get details of a Jenkins job: description, buildability, queue state, health report, and the last, last successful, and last failed build numbers.

job.description: Full job path, e.g. my-job or team-a/service-x for a job inside a folder

tools.name: jenkins.get_build
tools.description: Get details of a specific build of a job: result, timing, whether it is still building, build parameters, causes, and changelog entries.

job.description: Full job path, e.g. my-job or team-a/service-x

tools.name: jenkins.get_console_log
tools.description: Fetch the console log of a build, either from a byte offset (for incremental reads of running builds) or just the last N KiB via tailKb. Returns whether more output is expected.

job.description: Full job path, e.g. my-job or team-a/service-x

start.description: Byte offset to read from (default 0). Ignored when tailKb is set.

tailKb.description: Return only the last N KiB of the log (max 256). Useful for long logs.

tools.name: jenkins.get_queue
tools.description: List items waiting in the Jenkins build queue with the reason each one is waiting and how long it has been queued.

tools.name: jenkins.trigger_build
tools.description: Trigger a build of a job, optionally with build parameters. The build's impact depends entirely on what the job does (deploys, releases, etc.). Returns the queue item URL.

job.description: Full job path, e.g. my-job or team-a/service-x

parameters.description: Build parameters as name/value pairs. When provided, buildWithParameters is used instead of build.
